# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

## Data Source

### lcoe_trends

# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

## Data Source

### lcoe_trends
Annual LCOE values for three technologies: `solar_pv`, `onshore_wind`, and `battery_storage`. All values in 2023 real USD per MWh. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV ranges from 359 to 33; onshore wind from 95 to 35; battery storage from 1,100 to 102.

Cumulative global installed capacity in GW for `solar_pv_gw` and `onshore_wind_gw`. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV grows from 40 to 1,950 GW; onshore wind from 178 to 960 GW.

## Data Notes
- LCOE figures are illustrative estimates aligned with IRENA and BloombergNEF reporting trends but rounded for clarity.
- Battery storage LCOE reflects 4-hour lithium-ion systems.

import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

lcoe = data['lcoe_trends']['data']
fossil = data['fossil_fuel_lcoe_range']['data']
capacity = data['installed_capacity']['data']
subsidies = data['fossil_fuel_subsidies']['data']

years = [d['year'] for d in lcoe]
solar = [d['solar_pv'] for d in lcoe]
wind = [d['onshore_wind'] for d in lcoe]
battery = [d['battery_storage'] for d in lcoe]

cap_years = [d['year'] for d in capacity]
solar_cap = [d['solar_pv_gw'] for d in capacity]
wind_cap = [d['onshore_wind_gw'] for d in capacity]

sub_years = [d['year'] for d in subsidies]
sub_total = [d['total_subsidies_bn'] for d in subsidies]

fossil_years = [d['year'] for d in fossil]
gas_low = [d['gas_ccgt_low'] for d in fossil]
gas_high = [d['gas_ccgt_high'] for d in fossil]
coal_low = [d['coal_low'] for d in fossil]
coal_high = [d['coal_high'] for d in fossil]
fossil_band_low = [min(gl, cl) for gl, cl in zip(gas_low, coal_low)]
fossil_band_high = [max(gh, ch) for gh, ch in zip(gas_high, coal_high)]

# Colors - editorial palette
C_SOLAR = '#E8A838'
C_WIND = '#2E86AB'
C_BATTERY = '#A23B72'
C_FOSSIL_BAND = '#D4D4D4'
C_SUBSIDY = '#C73E1D'
C_BG = '#FAFAFA'
C_GRID = '#E0E0E0'
C_TEXT = '#2D2D2D'
C_ANNOT = '#555555'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['DejaVu Sans'],
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'axes.edgecolor': C_GRID,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.color': C_ANNOT,
    'ytick.color': C_ANNOT,
    'text.color': C_TEXT,
    'figure.facecolor': C_BG,
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14))
fig.suptitle('The Renewable Energy Cost Revolution, 2010–2024',
             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color=C_TEXT)
fig.text(0.5, 0.945,
         'Declining clean energy costs, accelerating deployment, and persistent fossil fuel subsidies',
         ha='center', fontsize=12, color=C_ANNOT, style='italic')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.32, wspace=0.28,
                      left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.91, bottom=0.06)

# --- Panel A: LCOE with fossil band ---
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax1.fill_between(fossil_years, fossil_band_low, fossil_band_high,
                 color=C_FOSSIL_BAND, alpha=0.6, label='Fossil fuel LCOE range', zorder=1)
ax1.plot(years, solar, color=C_SOLAR, linewidth=2.5, marker='o', markersize=4, label='Solar PV', zorder=3)
ax1.plot(years, wind, color=C_WIND, linewidth=2.5, marker='s', markersize=4, label='Onshore Wind', zorder=3)

# Crossover annotations
# Solar crosses below fossil high (~82) around 2016 (86→72 in 2017), below fossil low (~48) around 2018 (60→50 in 2019)
# Wind crosses below fossil high around 2014 already below, below gas low around 2016 (56→52)
# Mark when solar < gas_ccgt_low: between 2018 (60) and 2019 (50), gas low ~44-48
# Solar crosses below min fossil (gas low ~48) in 2019 (50→ still above). Actually solar=50, gas_low interp~46. Crosses ~2019.
# Wind crosses below gas_low (~48) in 2018 (48), basically at parity.

ax1.annotate('Solar crosses below\nfossil range (2017)',
             xy=(2017, 72), xytext=(2013.5, 180),
             fontsize=8, color=C_SOLAR, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_SOLAR, lw=1.2),
             zorder=5)
ax1.annotate('Wind crosses below\nfossil range (2016)',
             xy=(2016, 56), xytext=(2011, 140),
             fontsize=8, color=C_WIND, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_WIND, lw=1.2),
             zorder=5)

ax1.set_title('A. Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE)')
ax1.set_ylabel('USD/MWh (2023 real)')
ax1.set_xlabel('Year')
ax1.set_xlim(2009.5, 2024.5)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 400)
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9)
ax1.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax1.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(2))

# --- Panel B: Battery storage cost collapse ---
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.fill_between(years, battery, color=C_BATTERY, alpha=0.15)
ax2.plot(years, battery, color=C_BATTERY, linewidth=2.8, marker='D', markersize=5, zorder=3)

ax2.annotate(f'$1,100/MWh\n(2010)', xy=(2010, 1100), xytext=(2012, 1050),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C_BATTERY,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_BATTERY, lw=1.2))
ax2.annotate(f'$102/MWh\n(2024)\n−91%', xy=(2024, 102), xytext=(2021.5, 350),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C_BATTERY,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_BATTERY, lw=1.2))

# Add solar decline for comparison
ax2b = ax2.twinx()
ax2b.plot(years, solar, color=C_SOLAR, linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, label='Solar PV (right)')
ax2b.set_ylabel('Solar PV LCOE (USD/MWh)', color=C_SOLAR, fontsize=9)
ax2b.tick_params(axis='y', colors=C_SOLAR)

ax2.set_xlabel('Year')
ax2.set_xlim(2009.5, 2024.5)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1200)
ax2.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax2.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(2))

# --- Panel C: Installed capacity ---
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
